functions.name: ChDir
functions.description: Changes the current directory or folder.

functions.name: EOF
functions.description: Returns an Integer containing the Boolean value True when the end of a file opened for Random or sequential Input has been reached.

functions.name: FileAttr
functions.signature: FileAttr(FileNumber As Integer, [ReturnType As Integer]) As Long
functions.description: Returns a Long representing the file mode for files opened by using the Open statement.

parameters.name: FileNumber
parameters.description: Required; Integer. Any valid file number.

parameters.name: ReturnType
parameters.description: Required; Integer. Number indicating the type of information to return. Specify 1 to return a value indicating the file mode. On 16-bit systems only, specify 2 to retrieve an operating system file handle. _Returntype_ 2 is not supported in 32-bit systems and causes an error.

functions.name: FileCopy
functions.signature: FileCopy(Source As String, Destination As String)

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description: Required. String expression that specifies the name of the file to be copied. The _source_ may include directory or folder, and drive.

parameters.name: Destination
parameters.description: Required. String expression that specifies the target file name. The _destination_ may include directory or folder, and drive.

functions.name: FileDateTime
functions.description: Returns a Variant (Date) that indicates the date and time when a file was created or last modified.

functions.name: FileLen
functions.description: Returns a Long specifying the length of a file in bytes.

functions.name: GetAttr
functions.description: Returns an Integer representing the attributes of a file, directory, or folder.

functions.name: Loc
functions.description: Returns a Long specifying the current read/write position within an open file.

functions.name: LOF
functions.description: Returns a Long representing the size, in bytes, of a file opened by using the Open statement.

functions.name: MkDir
functions.description: Creates a new directory or folder.

functions.name: Reset
functions.description: Closes all disk files opened by using the Open statement.

functions.name: RmDir
functions.description: Removes an existing directory or folder.

functions.name: Seek
functions.description: Returns a Long specifying the current read/write position within a file opened by using the Open statement.

functions.name: SetAttr
functions.signature: SetAttr(PathName As String, Attributes As VbFileAttribute)
functions.description: Sets attribute information for a file.

parameters.name: PathName
parameters.description: Required. String expression that specifies a file name; may include directory or folder, and drive.

parameters.name: Attributes
parameters.description: Required. Constant or numeric expression whose sum specifies file attributes.

functions.name: FreeFile
functions.description: Returns an Integer representing the next file number available for use by the Open statement.

functions.name: Dir
functions.signature: Dir([PathName As Variant], [Attributes As VbFileAttribute]) As String
functions.description: Returns a String representing the name of a file, directory, or folder that matches a specified pattern or file attribute, or the volume label of a drive.

parameters.name: PathName
parameters.description: Optional. String expression that specifies a file name; may include directory or folder, and drive. A zero-length string ("") is returned if _pathname_ is not found.

parameters.name: Attributes
parameters.description: Optional. Constant or numeric expression, whose sum specifies file attributes. If omitted, returns files that match _pathname_ but have no attributes.
